Spectate: Within 3s after Yachiru releases her technique or successfully counters, switch her to the backline to have her Spectate. rationale: Tier B reflects a kit that works, but with real caveats: Yachiru Kusajishi performs well in the right matchups or team, while more universal picks outperform them elsewhere. As a Support, this build is judged by what it lets the rest of the team do — the picks below prioritize uptime, sustain, and buff coverage over personal damage. The Slash damage type also matters here: content weak to it is where this build over-performs its tier, and content resistant to it is where you should bench accordingly.

The recommended set — Hidden Wisdom (3) — is chosen for how the set bonus lines up with the kit's actual damage profile, not because it's generically strong. Main stats go 1: ATK% > Slash DMG  •  2: Crit Rate  •  3: Ult Charge Rate for the same reason: they feed what the kit multiplies. Ult Charge Rate leads the priority because the kit's value is concentrated in its Ultimate — getting it back faster beats making everything else slightly bigger. Has stronger buffs when paired with Kenpachi.

We call B0 the stopping point because that's where the boundary curve bends: the levels up to it unlock the pieces the kit is actually balanced around, while the levels past it mostly buy stat percentages at dupe prices. For free-to-play rosters that means settling at B2 and moving on; if dupes are no object, B6 is where the value per copy finally flattens out.
The featured rotation ("Buff Hop") is ordered the way it is to stack the kit's multipliers before the big hits land — the sequence matters more than the buttons. 2 buttons.
Bond priority starts with Mayuri Bond because it feeds the stat the rest of this page is built around — later bonds are nice-to-haves, this one changes the math.

As with everything on this page, these calls come from community testing plus the wiki's numbers — when the data changes (balance patches, new stamps, better testing), the recommendations and this reasoning get updated together.
